decisions.reason: The multi-model handle family carries tooling and catalogue investment that a long-established hardware maker will keep justifying, and two years is too short to judge uptake in slow specification cycles.
The mitred family expresses the firm's proprietary engineering and design identity, so sunk development costs and brand commitment outweigh its modest visibility.
The multifunctional handle fits the announced barrier-free one-stop direction, and slow early uptake can still be attributed to construction planning lead times.
The line is embedded in coordinated handle families and planning documentation, which makes withdrawal after two years unlikely.
The collection won the German Design Award and was publicly promoted on its own page, so strong visible commitment and a positive result make keeping it the clear choice.
The finish costs little to maintain, applies across product families and showcases the firm's finishing expertise, so there is little reason to withdraw it.
